description: Immutable data object for loan charge data, encapsulating details about charges associated with loans including amounts, dates, calculation types, and related metadata.

classes.name: LoanChargeData
classes.description: Immutable data object for loan charge data, containing fields for various charge details, constructors for different initialization scenarios, and methods for state checks like charge payability and installment fee status.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template instance of LoanChargeData with provided charge options.

methods.name: newLoanChargeDetails
methods.description: Creates a new LoanChargeData instance populated with charges from definition for CRUD operations.

methods.name: isChargePayable
methods.description: Determines whether the charge is payable based on its payment mode and status.

methods.name: isInstallmentFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an installment fee based on its charge time type.

methods.name: updateAmountAccrued
methods.description: Updates the amount accrued for the loan charge.
